SELECT FROM users u
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR u.full_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR u.email ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))

SELECT n.title, n.body, n.data ->> 'deepLink' AS deep_link, min(n.created_at) AS sent_at, count(*) AS recipient_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.is_read) AS read_count FROM notifications n WHERE n.type IN ('ADMIN_ANNOUNCEMENT', 'ADMIN_MESSAGE')
AND (n.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR n.body ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
GROUP BY n.title, n.body, n.data ->> 'deepLink', date_trunc('minute', n.created_at) ORDER BY
n.title count(*) count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.is_read) min(n.created_at)
DESC NULLS LAST ASC NULLS LAST
, min(n.created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.type IN ('ADMIN_ANNOUNCEMENT', 'ADMIN_MESSAGE')
AND (n.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR n.body ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
GROUP BY n.title, n.body, n.data ->> 'deepLink', date_trunc('minute', n.created_at) ) batches
